claim: 相对 Langlands 把 Langlands 从约化群推广到球簇 G-簇 X，X=G 时回到通常情形

sources.name: nLab relative Langlands program
sources.quote: The relative Langlands program is a generalization of the Langlands program that is phrased in terms of spherical varieties instead of directly in terms of reductive groups.

sources.name: Sakellaridis, Spherical varieties, functoriality, and quantization (ICM 2022 survey), arXiv:2111.03004
sources.quote: We discuss generalizations of the Langlands program, from reductive groups to the local and automorphic spectra of spherical varieties
sources.bearing: 支持：同一推广方向，独立于 nLab

note: 两源一致把「相对」定义为「群→球簇」。nLab 补充「X=G 时回到通常 Langlands」为 expected（预期），卡片陈述为既定事实，属措辞强度差异，不构成矛盾。

sources.quote: instead of focusing on a spherical variety X, the main focus is on a Hamiltonian G-space M, which is often related to X via its cotangent bundle M = T*X
sources.bearing: 支持：M 才是主对象，M=T*X

sources.name: Ben-Zvi–Sakellaridis–Venkatesh, Relative Langlands Duality, arXiv:2409.04677
sources.quote: This duality pairs a Hamiltonian space for a group $G$ with a Hamiltonian space under its dual group $\check{G}$

sources.bearing: 部分支持：Plancherel 确与「对偶群参数」相关，但仍记作 should be related（猜想），且对偶群只是 closely related to Gaitsgory–Nadler 的构造，未说成 M̌ 的 q-特征标

sources.quote: We propose a duality in the relative Langlands program.
sources.bearing: 支持：propose，非 prove

note: nLab 无 geometric Satake 条目（https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/geometric+Satake+correspondence 返回 404），第二独立来源未取得；仅凭 MV 原文一条强来源判 supported。

claim: 定理 8.19：X 球簇 ⟺ F[X] 作 H_G-模多重数自由，已证

sources.quote: forces the multiplicity-freeness of the Hamiltonian space M̌
sources.bearing: 削弱：多重数自由在文中是局部猜想 + Poisson 结构「逼出」的结论，而非一条已证的双向定理

sources.bearing: 部分支持：存在 Atiyah 1989 的公理清单，但外部并未把它压成两条

sources.name: nLab functorial field theory
sources.quote: A local (“extended”, “multi-tiered”) refinement of this is naturally given by passing from 1-functors to (∞,n)-functors on (∞,n)-categories of cobordisms.
sources.bearing: 部分支持：「局部/族上」是 1-函子版本之外的 extended/local 精细化，不是 Atiyah 原公理之一

sources.name: nLab cobordism category

sources.bearing: 支持（并提示约定差异）：当前主流约定即「对象=闭 (n-1)-流形、态射=配边」

claim: 无交并给对称幺半结构

sources.name: nLab functorial field theory

sources.name: nLab Dijkgraaf-Witten theory

sources.bearing: 支持：目标空间为 BG，故场空间是 Map(Σ,BG)

sources.name: nLab 2d TQFT

sources.bearing: 部分支持：2 维给圆上的代数结构（C[G/G] 型），但未给「顶维 #X / 余维一 C[X] / 余维二 Vect[X]」的三档分类
